_comment: One row per hook registration (0.3.0, KIT-03). tools/settings.mjs renders this file and nothing else does: -Plugin into hooks/hooks.json as node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/<script>", -Vendored into a repository's .claude/settings.json as node "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/kit/<script>". Row order is render order. event: the Claude Code hook event. matcher: the tool or source pattern; a row without one fires on every call of its event. script: the path under the kit root. timeout: seconds. host: any, pc or cloud; -Host pc keeps the rows that name pc or any, -Host cloud likewise. mode: what the script does when it fires, deny, advise or gate; informational, the grade generator reads the script's anchor lines. vendor: true when tools/vendor.json carries the script into .claude/kit/. Never hand-edit hooks/hooks.json: run node tools/settings.mjs -Plugin -Out hooks/hooks.json and commit both files.
